analysis.d: FIVE OF FIVE AUTHORED, AND THE HETERONYM HOLDS AN INSTITUTION AND A DATE RANGE. "Four Works of Johannes Sigil (1711–2026)" — a lifespan spanning three centuries, composed without comment.
analysis.reading:
THE DISCLOSURE IS IN THE SNIPPET AND THE LAYER PASSES IT ON UNREMARKED. Card 4 announces itself as "a DISCLOSED RETROCAUSAL CANON INSTALLATION of four sigillographic texts into the New Human Canon. THREE ARE REAL HISTORICAL WORKS" — the archive stating openly that one of the four is not, and that the installation is deliberate. The title carries the date range "(1711–2026)". The layer composes all of this as ordinary bibliography.

Every card credits the "Johannes Sigil Institute for Comparative Poetics", so the heteronym is retrieved with an institutional affiliation across Medium, Academia and PhilPapers alike. Compare «johannes sigil teacher», which returned MANUS’s actual Detroit teaching post: the same heteronym holds a fictional institute and a real classroom in adjacent captures.
